statement: Let P = 2*(n-1). Whenever pass_the_pillow n time returns a result ans, let q be the unique integer such that 0 <= q < P and time = k*P + q for some nonnegative integer k. Then ans = 1+q if q <= n-1, and ans = 2*n - 1 - q if q > n-1. This is exactly the 1-based index of the person holding the pillow after time seconds in the bouncing pass sequence that starts at person 1.
preconditions: n and time are integers with 2 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= time <= 1000.

statement: For every n and time satisfying the preconditions, pass_the_pillow n time returns a result ans; it does not fail, overflow, panic, or access an out-of-bounds index.
preconditions: n and time are integers with 2 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= time <= 1000.

statement: Whenever pass_the_pillow n time returns a result ans, 1 <= ans <= n.
preconditions: n and time are integers with 2 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= time <= 1000.

statement: Whenever pass_the_pillow n time returns a result ans, ans = time + 1.
preconditions: n and time are integers with 2 <= n <= 1000, 1 <= time <= 1000, and time <= n-1.

statement: Whenever pass_the_pillow n time returns a result ans, ans = 2*n - 1 - time.
preconditions: n and time are integers with 2 <= n <= 1000, 1 <= time <= 1000, and n <= time <= 2*(n-1).

statement: Whenever pass_the_pillow 2 time returns a result ans, ans = 1 if time is even, and ans = 2 if time is odd.
If t1 ≡ t2 (mod 2*(n-1)), then whenever pass_the_pillow n t1 returns ans1 and pass_the_pillow n t2 returns ans2, we have ans1 = ans2.
preconditions: n is an integer with 2 <= n <= 1000, and t1, t2 are integers with 1 <= t1 <= 1000 and 1 <= t2 <= 1000.

statement: If t1 + t2 ≡ 0 (mod 2*(n-1)), then whenever pass_the_pillow n t1 returns ans1 and pass_the_pillow n t2 returns ans2, we have ans1 = ans2.
preconditions: n is an integer with 2 <= n <= 1000, and t1, t2 are integers with 1 <= t1 <= 1000 and 1 <= t2 <= 1000.

statement: Whenever pass_the_pillow n time returns a result ans, ans = n if and only if time ≡ n-1 (mod 2*(n-1)).
preconditions: n and time are integers with 2 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= time <= 1000.

statement: Whenever pass_the_pillow n time returns a result ans, ans = 1 if and only if time ≡ 0 (mod 2*(n-1)).
preconditions: n and time are integers with 2 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= time <= 1000.

statement: Let P = 2*(n-1). Whenever pass_the_pillow n time returns a result ans, ans = 2 if and only if time ≡ 1 (mod P) or time ≡ P-1 (mod P).
preconditions: n and time are integers with 2 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= time <= 1000.
